title: Rosemary Beach: Popp's Place in Rosemary Beach | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

If you like to step out of your building and be near all the action, then this is the vacation rental for you! Popp's Place is located overlooking North Barrett Square above the iconic Rosemary Beach Trading Company.

The large corner balcony is perfect for an afternoon cocktail or a meal in the crisp ocean air. The loft features long hallways, tall ceilings, and an open living concept. Whether visiting for work or play, Popp's Place is a great spot to call home during your visit to the beach.

The guest suite offers a queen bed and flat screen television. The shared hallway bath is just around the corner and features a tiled shower/tub combo. The master suite has an inviting King bed and private master bath. The master suite also has a flat screen television. The walk-in shower is beautifully tiled with a built-in seat, the tub has relaxing jacuzzi settings. A bonus sleeping space offers a set of bunk beds, full over full.

In the fully equipped kitchen, there are stainless steel appliances and a breakfast bar with seating for 3. The dining room and living room are open to each other with views of Barrett Square and East Long Green Park. The dining table seats six. During down time, watch a movie on the large flat screen TV or take a nap in the sunlight on the couch. Feeling like a little music? Turn on the Sonos System and play music right from your phone. The living room features a Harmony Elite Smart Remote to control all media settings in one easy-to-use remote.

Popp's Place includes 2 adult rental bikes complimentary with every stay along with complimentary access to Rosemary Beach Fitness & Tennis. Access to Rosemary Beach's four distinct community pools and private beach access.

**This property requires a 4 night minimum stay during spring break and summer and a 2 night minimum stay during shoulder season.

Disclaimer: Active balcony construction on neighboring building during January-Mid-April 2026.
